functions.signature_disposition: Unified with fn_801B7DC8: fn_801B7D94 forwards its live u32 sequence argument to fn_801BD1EC and uses the common SequenceInfo layout. Retail codegen does not establish arity by itself, but this removes the contradictory declarations while preserving exact codegen.

functions.blocking_divergence: The outgoing-argument stores and call body align. The remaining differences are frame allocation and saved-register offsets: retail places the saved-register base at 0x3c while GC/1.2.5n places it at 0x44, leaving additional unused local slack below that base.
levers_tried: Declaration and initialization order: moving the fn_801BD1EC lookup ahead of result changed the generated frame to 0x50, but expanded the generated body and disrupted the otherwise aligned saved-register and body schedule; rejected.
Unused-local elimination: adding an unreferenced u32 local was optimized away and reproduced the retained candidate unchanged, including its 0x58 frame; no removable source local explains the slack.
Parameter narrowing: widening arg13 from u8 to u32 expanded the generated body and reduced the objdiff match; rejected.
Save mechanism: the retained candidate and retail both use inline stmw/lmw rather than __save_gpr helpers, so helper selection does not explain the frame delta.

stop_rationale: The preceding reconstruction run stopped at its mandated scheduler cutoff before opening fn_801B7E84. Its exact elapsed duration was not independently measured in this remediation and is unverified. This remediation did not advance the frontier.
